scope.execution: Pure offline replay over retained JSON/log text and source; no engine, Vitest, test, build, campaign, replay, source/config mutation, or new discovery.

algorithm_binding.ordering: durationMs descending, then strict file path; each row goes to lowest totalDurationMs, then lowest shard index

unknown_17_sensitivity.note: Observed jsdom quantiles are illustrative sensitivity points, not bounds on an unobserved or blocked file.

partitioned_execution_treatment.model: Common independent load range added once to each shard; the four values are not treated as identical cases or assigned to a specific index.

overhead_sensitivity.application: Illustrative only: add this range to each modeled test-load range. It is not a bound for unfinished shard 1 or for a new run.

findings: Replacing retained planning weights with observed 718 completion durations sharply reduces modeled known-work spread while preserving every planned parallel and serial member.
The result is robust across illustrative 1s, observed-jsdom p50, p90, and max substitutions for the 17 unknown paths at the model-load level.

The model does not predict wall completion: missing-file runtime has no finite retained bound, per-worker overhead is not composable from file lines, execution order/cache state is absent, and resource contention or a blocked file remains unmeasured.
causal_wording: Planner underweight and shard skew are the strongest measured contributor and are actionable in an offline model. They plausibly explain the timeout; they are not a proven exclusive or strict cause.
smallest_justified_next_action: Use this model only to decide whether a future, separately authorized diagnostic is worthwhile. The smallest causal diagnostic remains an exact-membership shard-1 replay with per-file start/finish telemetry and unchanged worker semantics. Do not change timeout, shard count, suite membership, threshold, or floors from this model, and do not treat it as a full-suite gate.
historical_status: 718 full-suite acceptance remains unmet; overall NO-GO and every historical/unadopted gate remain unchanged.
